Layout legend objects

Source: R/zz-gen-layout.R
go_legend.Rd

The object for the figure layout's legend (and legend2, legend3, ...: see update_legends()). go_legend() creates one, with exactly its properties; a named list with the same properties works too.

Usage

go_legend(
  ...,
  bgcolor = NULL,
  bordercolor = NULL,
  borderwidth = NULL,
  entrywidth = NULL,
  entrywidthmode = NULL,
  font = NULL,
  groupclick = NULL,
  groupdoubleclick = NULL,
  grouptitlefont = NULL,
  indentation = NULL,
  itemclick = NULL,
  itemdoubleclick = NULL,
  itemheight = NULL,
  itemsizing = NULL,
  itemwidth = NULL,
  maxheight = NULL,
  orientation = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  titleclick = NULL,
  titledoubleclick = NULL,
  tracegroupgap = NULL,
  traceorder = NULL,
  uirevision = NULL,
  valign = NULL,
  visible = NULL,
  x = NULL,
  xanchor = NULL,
  xref = NULL,
  y = NULL,
  yanchor = NULL,
  yref = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

...

Not for properties, which must be named in full: an abbreviated or unknown name is an error that suggests the right one.

bgcolor

Sets the legend background color. Defaults to `layout.paper_bgcolor`. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

bordercolor

Sets the color of the border enclosing the legend. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

borderwidth

Sets the width (in px) of the border enclosing the legend. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

entrywidth

Sets the width (in px or fraction) of the legend. Use 0 to size the entry based on the text width, when `entrywidthmode` is set to "pixels". Number in the interval [0, Inf].

entrywidthmode

Determines what entrywidth means. One of "fraction", "pixels".

font

Sets the font used to text the legend items. A go_font() object or named list, with properties color, family, lineposition, shadow, size, style, textcase, variant and weight (see go_font()).

groupclick

Determines the behavior on legend group item click. "toggleitem" toggles the visibility of the individual item clicked on the graph. "togglegroup" toggles the visibility of all items in the same legendgroup as the item clicked on the graph. One of "toggleitem", "togglegroup".

groupdoubleclick

Determines the behavior on legend group item double-click. "toggleitem" toggles the visibility of the individual item clicked on the graph. "togglegroup" toggles the visibility of all items in the same legendgroup as the item clicked on the graph. Defaults to the value of `groupclick`. One of "toggleitem", "togglegroup".

grouptitlefont

Sets the font for group titles in legend. Defaults to `legend.font` with its size increased about 10%. A go_font() object or named list, with properties color, family, lineposition, shadow, size, style, textcase, variant and weight (see go_font()).

indentation

Sets the indentation (in px) of the legend entries. Number in the interval [-15, Inf].

itemclick

Determines the behavior on legend item click. "toggle" toggles the visibility of the item clicked on the graph. "toggleothers" makes the clicked item the sole visible item on the graph. FALSE disables legend item click interactions. One of "toggle", "toggleothers", FALSE.

itemdoubleclick

Determines the behavior on legend item double-click. "toggle" toggles the visibility of the item clicked on the graph. "toggleothers" makes the clicked item the sole visible item on the graph. FALSE disables legend item double-click interactions. One of "toggle", "toggleothers", FALSE.

itemheight

Sets the height (in px) of the legend item fill swatch. A taller swatch shows more of a trace "fill" or "fillpattern". Only traces with a "fill" use this value. Every legend item grows to fit, so a larger value makes every row taller. Number in the interval [6, Inf].

itemsizing

Determines if the legend items symbols scale with their corresponding "trace" attributes or remain "constant" independent of the symbol size on the graph. One of "trace", "constant".

itemwidth

Sets the width (in px) of the legend item symbols (the part other than the title.text). Number in the interval [30, Inf].

maxheight

Sets the max height (in px) of the legend, or max height ratio (reference height * ratio) if less than or equal to 1. Default value is: 0.5 for horizontal legends; 1 for vertical legends. The minimum allowed height is 30px. For a ratio of 0.5, the legend will take up to 50% of the reference height before displaying a scrollbar. The reference height is the full layout height with the following exception: vertically oriented legends with a `yref` of `"paper", located to the side of the plot. In this case, the reference height is the plot height. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

orientation

Sets the orientation of the legend. One of "v", "h".

title

String (the title text), or a go_legend_title() object or named list, with properties font, side and text (see go_legend_title()).

titleclick

Determines the behavior on legend title click. "toggle" toggles the visibility of all items in the legend. "toggleothers" toggles the visibility of all other legends. FALSE disables legend title click interactions. Defaults to "toggle" when there are multiple legends, FALSE otherwise. Not supported for legends containing pie and pie-like traces. One of "toggle", "toggleothers", FALSE.

titledoubleclick

Determines the behavior on legend title double-click. "toggle" toggles the visibility of all items in the legend. "toggleothers" toggles the visibility of all other legends. FALSE disables legend title double-click interactions. Defaults to "toggleothers" when there are multiple legends, FALSE otherwise. Not supported for legends containing pie and pie-like traces. One of "toggle", "toggleothers", FALSE.

tracegroupgap

Sets the amount of vertical space (in px) between legend groups. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

traceorder

Determines the order at which the legend items are displayed. If "normal", the items are displayed top-to-bottom in the same order as the input data. If "reversed", the items are displayed in the opposite order as "normal". If "grouped", the items are displayed in groups (when a trace `legendgroup` is provided). if "grouped+reversed", the items are displayed in the opposite order as "grouped". Any combination of "reversed", "grouped" joined with "+", or one of "normal".

uirevision

Controls persistence of legend-driven changes in trace and pie label visibility. Defaults to `layout.uirevision`. Any value.

valign

Sets the vertical alignment of the symbols with respect to their associated text. One of "top", "middle", "bottom".

visible

Determines whether or not this legend is visible. Logical.

x

Sets the x position with respect to `xref` (in normalized coordinates) of the legend. When `xref` is "paper", defaults to 1.02 for vertical legends and defaults to 0 for horizontal legends. When `xref` is "container", defaults to 1 for vertical legends and defaults to 0 for horizontal legends. Must be between 0 and 1 if `xref` is "container". and between "-2" and 3 if `xref` is "paper". Number.

xanchor

Sets the legend's horizontal position anchor. This anchor binds the `x` position to the "left", "center" or "right" of the legend. Value "auto" anchors legends to the right for `x` values greater than or equal to 2/3, anchors legends to the left for `x` values less than or equal to 1/3 and anchors legends with respect to their center otherwise. One of "auto", "left", "center", "right".

xref

Sets the container `x` refers to. "container" spans the entire `width` of the plot. "paper" refers to the width of the plotting area only. One of "container", "paper".

y

Sets the y position with respect to `yref` (in normalized coordinates) of the legend. When `yref` is "paper", defaults to 1 for vertical legends, defaults to "-0.1" for horizontal legends on graphs w/o range sliders and defaults to 1.1 for horizontal legends on graph with one or multiple range sliders. When `yref` is "container", defaults to 1. Must be between 0 and 1 if `yref` is "container" and between "-2" and 3 if `yref` is "paper". Number.

yanchor

Sets the legend's vertical position anchor. This anchor binds the `y` position to the "top", "middle" or "bottom" of the legend. Value "auto" anchors legends at their bottom for `y` values less than or equal to 1/3, anchors legends to at their top for `y` values greater than or equal to 2/3 and anchors legends with respect to their middle otherwise. One of "auto", "top", "middle", "bottom".

yref

Sets the container `y` refers to. "container" spans the entire `height` of the plot. "paper" refers to the height of the plotting area only. One of "container", "paper".

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

Value

A go_layout_legend object (a named list).

Details

Nested objects are named lists, or objects of the constructors their arguments name. Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when the object is created or modified. A property may be a one-sided formula (color = ~col): it is kept, and evaluated in the data (then checked) when its trace is added to a figure with add_<trace>() or add_trace().

Examples

mtcars |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(x = ~wt, y = ~mpg, mode = "markers") |>
  update_layout(legend = go_legend(visible = TRUE))
